arguments.useCase: Answer internal policy questions for 2,000 employees with citations

result.limitation: Validate assumptions and current AWS documentation. This is not an official AWS review, security audit, deployment or price quote.
result.useCase: Answer internal policy questions for 2,000 employees with citations

sizing.limitation: 500 tokens per page and 15% overlap are planning assumptions; measure on a sample

decisions: Parsers per format: pdf, docx, html, tables
Tables: keep as structured text or Markdown, never flatten into prose
Structure-aware chunking (headings, sections) before fixed windows
Attach metadata: source, section, date, tenant, ACL, language
Multilingual model if languages include pt-BR, en
Version the embedding model; re-embed on change
Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector) for exact terms, ids and acronyms
Authorization before retrieval: filter by ACL in the index query, never after the top-k
Top-k 20 then rerank to 5; measure recall on the eval set
Latency budget 4000 ms: retrieval + rerank should stay under 30% of it
Citations mandatory: answer must reference chunk ids; refuse when no chunk supports the claim
Golden Q&A set of at least 100 items with expected sources
Metrics: context recall, faithfulness, answer relevance, p95 latency, cost per answer
Regression on every model, prompt or chunking change

costDrivers: Embedding tokens at ingest and re-index
Egress and storage of source documents
openQuestions: Who owns corpus quality and deletion requests?
Which answers are high-stakes enough to require human review?
